column1: # Game profile of Pokémon Legends: Arceus (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.1.1 = v262144). Plays on the Mac
# Game Freak's engine between Sword's and Scarlet's Trinity, on SDK 11.4.0, NVN, Havok, Wwise, Pia / NPLN networking. The sdk build is Kirby and the Forgotten Land's; subsdk0 is the
# movie module, subsdk1 GLSLC. Started from the provisional profile scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py wrote from its survey (dm/games/profile_guess.py)
# the camera is on the right stick
# the game sets the near=0 depth mode (nvnDeviceSetDepthMode): the pipeline bases made before it runs take the main0_z vertex entries
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory); nninitStartup sets a 0.02 GB heap and initializes malloc's StandardAllocator over 32 GB of address space, which the
# host gives what the alias region has room for (4.06 GB). The SDK-wide node area and 32 MB region alignment patches (dm/tools/sdk_patches.py) let it fit after the 62 MB node area
# 12,851 shaders, by where each first appears: 11,352 in the effects' particle files (bin/effect/**/*.ptcl), 1,386 in the loose BNSH files (system_resource/gfx2/shader, the scene's
# materials, terrain, water, lighting, shadows and post effects), 73 in the 678 GFPAK archives under bin/archive (Oodle Kraken entries, decoded with the game's own OodleLZ_Decompress), 40 in main
